bifrost: springboard/audiod, springboard/src/media/capture.rs, springboard/proto/src/svc.rs (microphone capture only; no classifier)
summary: Apple's framework classifies sounds (over 300 built-in labels, or a custom Core ML model) in audio files and live streams. BifrOSt has no sound classification at all. The audio service owns the microphone and can record a take, but no SDK API exposes live audio to apps, and nothing classifies it.

features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 3 (theme-09, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Files can be decoded, but no analysis pass runs over them and no SDK type wraps this
The audio service owns the microphone and records takes (RecordStart and RecordStop in springboard/proto/src/svc.rs). Apps get no SDK access to the buffer stream

gaps: No sound classifier: no built-in label set (over 300 sounds) and no Core ML audio model path
No SDK audio input API: the audio service records to a file only (RecordStart and RecordStop), so apps cannot receive a live buffer stream
No analysis of audio files: springboard/src/media/audiofile.rs decodes files only
No result types for time-ranged classifications with confidences, and no observer delivery to apps
